jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance – Greenhouse Industry | $100,000–$140,000 + Bonus

Leamington, Ontario | Full-Time | Permanent | On-Site

Are you a hands-on finance leader who can go beyond reporting the numbers and help shape business decisions? Do you have experience with cash flow, budgeting, financial controls and strategic planning?
We are recruiting a Director of Finance to join an established greenhouse business in Leamington, Ontario.
Applicants from Amherstburg, Harrow, Kingsville, Leamington, Wheatley, Tilbury, Chatham, Comber, Essex, Belle River, Lakeshore, Puce, Tecumseh, Windsor and surrounding area are encouraged to apply.

The Role

This is a hands-on leadership position within a business of approximately 75–110 employees depending on the growing season.
You will be responsible for:
· Month-end close, reconciliations and financial reporting
· Weekly management reporting, variance analysis and forecasting
· A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory accounting and purchasing controls
· Maintaining a rolling 26-week cash flow forecast
· Banking relationships, credit facilities, debt and working capital
· Annual operating, capital and cash flow budgets
· Maintaining a 3-year integrated financial model
· Internal controls, approvals and financial governance
· Cost control, margin analysis and profitability improvement
· Developing company and departmental KPIs
· Supporting the CEO with investments, pricing, capital expenditure and growth decisions
· Building dashboards and introducing finance automation and AI tools
· Managing and developing a small 2 + 1 finance team
· Identifying and managing government grants, subsidies and tax incentives

About You

· Senior finance leadership experience
· Strong financial planning, reporting and commercial decision-making skills
· Experience with banks, business owners and the CRA
· Strong knowledge of cash flow forecasting, budgeting, financial modelling and internal controls
· Experience developing and tracking business KPIs
· Greenhouse, agriculture or agri-food experience is an asset
· Must hold a valid Canadian Social Insurance Number

Compensation & Benefits

· $100,000–$140,000 base salary
· 10-15% bonus (individual + company performance)
· Salaried with benefits and 4 weeks’ vacation
· Permanent position on the client's payroll
· Potential for partial remote work after the initial 6-month training period

What's Next?

Ready to take ownership of the finance function and help shape the next stage of growth? Apply today
